en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a Romanesque cloister with an inner garden. The view looks along a covered arcade with thick twisted and paired columns, ornate carved capitals, and round arches framing another set of similar arches across the courtyard. The masonry appears medieval with decorative brick and stone patterns. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.
